digest.component_or_area: rebar config surface & ticket-event signing seam
propositions: Seven settled or retired config keys are approved for removal from the schema, parser, and rebar.toml so rebar runs clean with zero unknown-key warnings.
The verify.completion_floor_active feature is fully calibrated and should be activated by dogfooding in this project's rebar.toml.
The reconciler's inbound writer _write_event_file bypasses the signing seam and does not stamp author_id/author_email/author_sig on events.
Author fields should be stamped and signed inline before _write_event_file persists events, reusing _apply_authorship logic, to preserve the reconciler's deferred batch-commit orchestration.

Each ticket-event-writing environment (local dev, AWS review-bot/auto-lander, GitHub Actions reconciler/canary) needs a documented signing-key file-path delivery mechanism, with the require_authenticated flag flip out of scope.
A repo-wide documentation-accuracy sweep must remove references to every pruned config key from docs, help, and release notes.
